concept.interaction: Push either beam end down. The warm charging bull with contrasting bull_muzzle rises with a dark happy smile, or the bear rises with blue rounded tears connected to its eyes; both faces remain neutral at level. Hand-assemble base, stand, beam, bull_body, bear_body, shuttle, bear_mask, mouth_back, tear_back, bear_face, bull_muzzle, main_pin, retainer and mount_pin. Fixed stand peg shifts masks according to50*sin(theta).

novel_mechanisms.definition: A fixed stand peg50 mm above a rocking axle engages a vertical slot in a guided horizontal carrier, translating two opposed expression masks by50*sin(theta).

A printed headed shaft in clearance bores with a removable transverse cross-key blocks shaft axial exit while the key is installed. Keys are gravity-seated, so inversion retention remains unverified; no purchased hardware is used.

concept.print_stance: Base on footprint; stand and rear covers rear-face-down; animals, forward black face, beige muzzle and carrier on broad frontal faces; separate headed pins upright. Muzzle capture taper expands1 mm per side over1.6 mm build height before its1.2 mm rear cap.
risks: Guide friction, stability and printed-key handling require physical prototype checks.
Retainer keys are removable and gravity-seated; inversion retention is unverified.
Round1 independent review failed bull species and crying expression; round2 geometry requires fresh independent visual review.

Manager reports all14 roles passed isolated thickness, overhang and native visual checks; assembly, independent review and final verification remain separate evidence. No print-readiness or physical-operation claim follows from this documentation.
concept.signature_interaction: Each rising animal changes expression differently through one positive mechanical drive.
concept.summary: A desk seesaw whose rising bull reveals a happy smile and whose rising bear reveals blue tears, with both faces neutral at level.
concept.title: Bull Bear Seesaw
